_common.notes: All Make*Value funcs switch on the JSON type (String=0, Number=1, Object=2, Array=3, Boolean=4, Null=5). Every error string gets ' [@<json path>]' appended. A Null value (JSON null) in float/bool/string/stringlist returns NO value and NO error (silent; the module gets a null value). Literal kinds go through MakeMutator: string->StringLiteral, number->FloatLiteral, bool->BooleanLiteral, object->'Mutate'/'Var', array->FlatteningStringList (stringlist base only; any other base -> 'Invalid Value/Mutate'). A literal of the wrong class -> 'Mutate Type Error Expected "{base}" Found "{class}"' (class display names, e.g. CD2_Float_Mutator / StringLiteral). Implicit per-player arrays exist ONLY at the value level (MakeFloatValue/MakeBooleanValue/MakeStringValue/MakeFloatArrayValue); a float param nested inside a mutator goes through MakeMutator, where an array is 'Invalid Value/Mutate'. String comparisons on keys render as ==/!= in the decompile = KismetStringLibrary StriStri (case-insensitive) and maps/sets are TMap<FString>/TSet<FString> (case-insensitive), so 'Mutate' names and param keys are case-insensitive [inferred from UE FString semantics].

mutate_object.notes: GetMutatorClass: 'Mutate' is checked first (wins over 'Var'). Mutate value not a string -> 'Mutate value must be a String name.'; unknown name -> 'Unrecognized Mutate {name}.'; object with neither Mutate nor Var -> "Expected Mutator Object, but no 'Mutate' field found.". Names come from the asset registry: every CD2_Mutator subclass asset under /Game/_AssemblyStorm/CustomDifficulty2/Mutators (recursive), keyed by asset name. If the class is a CD2_Select_Mutator child it goes through MakeSelectorMutator (polymorphic); otherwise it must be a child of the base type the context wants, except a String mutator is accepted where a StringList is wanted (wrapped as a 1-element list by CD2_StringList_StringWrapper). Key 'Mutate' itself is skipped by every ConfigureMutator.

var.notes: Object without 'Mutate' but with 'Var' -> CD2_{Float,Boolean,String,StringList}_Variable_Mutator picked by the context's base type (other base -> 'Unsupported Variable Type.'). Only the key 'Var' is allowed (' No parameters are supported'); Var must be a string ('Var must be String'); empty -> '!! VAR MISSING !!'. Reads the CD2_VariableMonitor; a missing variable at evaluation logs "Missing Variable '{v}'" and yields 0/false/''/[] . StringList var falls back to a String var wrapped as [s]. Becomes ready only once the variable is published (OnVariableReady; name matched case-SENSITIVELY there). Update interval 0.5 s. NOTE: Var is NOT accepted directly by MakeRandIntervalsValue (an object without 'Mutate' is read as a range).

float.notes: Verified FORMAT.md. string/bool -> 'Mutate Type Error Expected "CD2_Float_Mutator" Found "StringLiteral"' etc. null -> silent no value. per_player_array.notes: CD2_Implicit_Player_Count (and ByPlayerCount): picks element index = playerCount-1, clamped to [0, len-1] (last element repeats for more players). playerCount = number of player characters if there is at least one AND mission time > 30 s, else the length of the network-sorted player-state array. Re-evaluated at least every 2 s. Elements go through MakeMutator with the context's base type (so a nested array inside is NOT per-player again). Waits for the PLS before ready. Element errors are reported (for bool/string/floatarray contexts).

randinterval.notes: Object without 'Mutate' is a range: 'Max' checked first ('Range Must Specify 'Max''), then 'Min' ('Range Must Specify 'Min''); 'Weight' optional, default 1 (FloatLiteral 1.0). Other keys in a range are ignored (no error). Min/Max/Weight each go through MakeMutator(float) so they may be literals, Mutate or Var objects (no per-player arrays). In the array form every element must be an object ('Expected Random Range'), bare numbers are not accepted; an element with 'Mutate' is still read as a range. A {"Var":...} object at top level is read as a range (error Max missing). string -> Mutate Type Error; bool/null -> 'Value Must be an RandInterval, Range or Float'.

selector.notes: MakeSelectorMutator: any Mutate whose class is a CD2_Select_Mutator child (Select, SelectFromArray, If, IfFloat, ByPlayerCount, RandomChoice, RandomChoicePerMission, ByBiome, ByMissionType, ByDNA, ByDDStage, BySecondary, ByMissionComplexity, ByMissionDuration, By*Phase, IfOnSpaceRig, and other readers' ByResuppliesCalled, Sequence, EnemyCooldown) is built with OptionsBaseClass = the context's base type, so every option is parsed with MakeMutator(<context type>) and the result is wrapped in CD2_{Float,Boolean,String,StringList}_Selector. So a Select-family mutator returns float, bool, string or stringlist depending on where it is used; all options must be that type. At evaluation the selector calls Select(); if the chosen option is null (no match, no Default) the selector leaves its output unset (0/false/''/[]). Base outside those four -> '!Internal Error! Unsupported Base Class For Selector'. RequiresAuthority/update interval forward to the select mutator.

SquareWave.notes: High when sin(360 * t / Period) > 0 else Low, t = mission time. ConfigureMutator collects errors (unknown key -> "Unexpected field \"\"", wrong type -> "Expected Float Value/Mutator") but then returns Errors = {} (SquareWave.cpp:232): every error is silently dropped and the bad param stays 0.

Enable.notes: Time accumulates while true. Error if absent: "'Enable' condition must be set."

AutoReset.notes: Reset to 0 whenever Enable is false

StopWatch.notes: Unknown key -> error "Unexpected field \"<key>\"" (UnexpectedFieldError). Seconds accumulated while Enable is true.

Subtract.notes: A - B. Other key -> 'Unexpected field "{field}", Use 'A' and 'B''.

RateOfChange.notes: Per second; defaults to 0 here (ByTime's default is 1)

TimeDelta.notes: Same formula as ByTime. Unknown key -> error "Unexpected Mutator Field"; 'Mutate' is compared case-SENSITIVELY here (TimeDelta.cpp:125). Stops at the first error.

Resource.notes: English name (enums.Resource keys) or the RES_* asset name; anything else counts 0. Error if absent: "\"Resource\" must be specified"

TotalResource.notes: Any other key -> error "Only \"Resource\" value is allowed for this Mutator". Held + deposited.

N.notes: cooldown seconds; '"N" seconds must be set.'

TriggerCooldown.notes: Output = input && !cooldown; a falling edge of the input starts an N-second cooldown. Requires authority (server).

TriggerDelay.notes: Replays the input's rising/falling edges N seconds later. Requires authority.

Reset.notes: when true, a new rising edge while triggered restarts the N-second window

TriggerFixedDuration.notes: A rising edge of the input outputs true for exactly N seconds. Requires authority.

N.notes: 'N must be set'; truncated to int

TriggerNTimes.notes: Input passes through for its first N true periods.

Value.notes: FLOAT input; any non-reserved key; 'Input Value must be set'

FallOnly.notes: 'RiseOnly and FallOnly are incompatible' when both keys are given

TriggerOnChange.notes: True on an evaluation where the float differs from the previous one (direction filtered by RiseOnly/FallOnly).

Value.notes: the input. Conventionally 'Value', but ANY key name not reserved is accepted as the input (first such key); a second one -> 'Unexpected field'. Missing -> 'Input Value must be set'

TriggerOnce.notes: Passes the input through only during its first true period (count of rising edges <= 1).

TriggerSometimes.notes: On each rising edge rolls once; if it hits, passes the input through for that true period. Requires authority.

TriggerSustain.notes: Output = input, and stays true N seconds after the input falls. Requires authority.

N.notes: period seconds; '"N" seconds must be set.'

Reset.notes: true holds the timer at N and outputs false

Enable.notes: inverse of Reset; "'Enable' and 'Reset' are mutually exclusive"

TriggerTimer.notes: No input. With Loop: true for one evaluation each time N seconds elapse. Without Loop: TimeRemaining is pinned at 0 after the first expiry, so it stays true until Reset (or Enable false). First evaluation only arms the timer. Requires authority.

registries_notes.ED: Vanilla DRG EnemyDescriptor object names (Dumper-7 vanilla dump, build 4.27.2-158958; cross-checked with the game pak's ED_* files). Registry = runtime asset-registry scan, no table in source (CD2_ED_Registry.cpp:68). 'Base' accepts only these (DefaultNames); other ED references also accept CD2-defined names.
registries_notes.PRJ: Registry = every BlueprintGeneratedClass whose native parent derives AProjectile or whose asset name starts 'PRJ_', kept if the loaded class is an AProjectile (CD2_PRJ_Registry.cpp:111); name = class name incl. '_C' (writing without '_C' also works). List = vanilla SDK AProjectile BP subclasses + pak PRJ_* assets (PRJ_ZipLineGun* unverified: not loaded in the dump).
registries_notes.Material: Registry = every MaterialInstanceConstant asset name (CD2_Material_Registry.cpp:111). List = MICs loaded in the vanilla dump: a lower bound, the cooked asset registry may hold more. Materials also accepts 'Default' and 'Random'.
registries_notes.ED_mods: The ED registry is filled at runtime from the asset registry (every EnemyDescriptor asset, after scanning /Game/yinnys_addon and /Game/NewEnemies; CD2_ED_Registry.cpp:82). These EDs exist only when those other mods are installed (from a modded Dumper-7 object dump). Plus every name defined as a key of Enemies in the same config.
